test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Krishi Sakhi Convergence Programme (KSCP), under the Lakhpati Didi programme, was launched from which of the following places in June 2024 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Krishi Sakhi Convergence Programme (KSCP)** is an initiative under the **Lakhpati Didi** programme.
 
• This programme was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in **June 2024**.
 
• It was launched from the ancient city of **Varanasi**, which is also known for its rich cultural and historical heritage.
 
• The aim of the KSCP is to empower rural women by providing them with skills and resources in **agriculture** and **allied activities**.
 
• The programme seeks to improve the livelihood of rural women and make them **lakhpatis** (earning more than one lakh rupees annually).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lucknow**__

 __
 
• **Lucknow** is the capital city of the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It is known for its rich history, culture, and heritage, including landmarks such as the **Bara Imambara** and **Chota Imambara**.
 
• Lucknow is also famous for its unique style of **Chikankari embroidery**.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**__
 __
 
• **Ahmedabad** is the largest city in the Indian state of **Gujarat**.
 
• It is an important economic and industrial hub, known for its textile industry.
 
• The city is home to the **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport** and the **Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM-A)**.
 
 
 
• **Nagpur**__
 
 
• **Nagpur** is a major city in the central part of India, located in the state of **Maharashtra**.
 
• It is known as the **Orange City** due to its famous Nagpur oranges.
 
• Nagpur is also the geographical center of India and houses the **Zero Mile Stone**.
